about:
# ForeverMeter

Damage, healing, damage taken and threat meter for **WoW Forever** (client 1.60, 12.x engine).
Pure Lua, no libraries required: one main file, a settings mirror and 11 locale files.

> **First install: restart the game once.** The game only loads new texture and font files at startup,
> so `/reload` is not enough the first time. After an update, `/reload` is usually enough; restart if something looks missing.

## What's new in 1.17.0
- **Report channel**: `/fm report [N] guild`, `say`, `party`, `raid`, `instance` or `whisper <name>`; instance groups get the report in instance chat.
- **Mode of any window**: `/fm mode threat 2`.
- **New commands**: `/fm rowheight`, `/fm bgalpha`, `/fm autohide`, `/fm instanceonly`, `/fm autoreset`.
- **Minimize a window** to its title bar (button left of the gear), and **hide outside instances** (options panel).
- **Themes**: `classic`, `flat`, `glass`, `compact` (options panel or `/fm theme`).
- **Threat first** in the Display menu; clicking Menu again closes it.

### 1.16.0
- **Avoidable and deadly spells** marked in the damage taken breakdown and tooltip.
- **Death recap to chat**: shift-click a death, or `/fm report death [N]`.
- **Settings export and import**: `/fm export`, `/fm import`, or the options panel.
- **Boss filter** for enemy damage taken, **bar colour** per window, windows, rows and width in the options panel.

### 1.15.1
- **Threat warning with MuscaUI**: ForeverMeter no longer plays its sound when MuscaUI already warns.

### 1.15.0
- **Threat against a boss**: the game hides the numbers, so each bar shows the threat status instead
  (aggro, insecure aggro, above the tank). The warning goes off when you are above the tank.
- **Threat warning**: the sound plays again only after your threat has stayed below the threshold for 3 seconds.

Earlier versions: see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dldvlpr-addons-wow/threatMeter/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Why a dedicated meter
On this engine, `COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED` is forbidden to addons (ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN popup).
Data comes from `C_DamageMeter`, Blizzard's server-side meter. In combat, names, amounts and GUIDs
are "secret values": they can be displayed, but not compared or summed. The addon shows the bars
in the order returned by the API and fills in the rest (percentages, per-spell breakdown) out of combat.
Threat comes from `UnitDetailedThreatSituation`. Against a boss, where the values are secret, the bars
show the status from `UnitThreatSituation` (aggro, insecure aggro, above the tank) without numbers.

## Installation
Install from CurseForge or Wago, or copy the folder into
`World of Warcraft/_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/ForeverMeter/`
(the folder must be named `ForeverMeter`, like the `.toc` file).

## Features
- Modes: damage, healing, absorbs, damage taken, enemy damage taken, avoidable damage taken, interrupts, dispels, deaths, threat.
  Enemy and avoidable damage taken appear only when the client knows these meter types.
- Up to 4 windows, each with its own mode, session and position (damage and healing side by side, for example).
  Menu → **New window** (first entry) / Windows → **Close this window**, or `/fm windows 2`.
- New window: same size and lock state as the window it comes from, attached to the first free side
  (below, right, above, left) without going off screen or covering another window.
- Snapping: dropping a window against the edge of another snaps it (it then follows that window's moves
  and size); dragging it away detaches it.
- Size: grips in the bottom-right and bottom-left corners of each window (width and number of rows, per window).
  `/fm rows` and `/fm width` set a shared size and clear per-window sizes.
- Your own bar: when you rank below the visible rows, it takes the last row with your real rank (windows of 2 rows or more).
- Per window, from its menu: Bar text (total, per second, percent), and in Windows: **My bar only**, **No title bar**, **Big number**, **Minimize**.
  Menu → Display → **DPS**: damage with the per second value only.
- Sessions: current fight, overall, or any fight kept by the client.
- **Menu** button (or right-click on the title): new window, modes, then submenus Session, Windows, Bar text,
  Bar colour (and Enemies shown in enemy damage taken); table, copy as text, options, reset. **Reset** button: clears data.
- Padlock in the title bar: locks position and size of that window only (`/fm lock` / `unlock`: all windows).
- Gear in the title bar: opens the options.
- Hover a bar: top 5 spells of that source. Click: per-spell breakdown (icon, total, per second). Mouse wheel: scroll; over the title: change mode.
  The breakdown is a separate panel above the meter windows; drag its title to move it, its position is kept.
- Shift-click a second bar while the breakdown is open: spell-by-spell comparison of both sources ("12.3k | 9.8k (+26%)"), out of combat only.
- Specialization icon when the client provides one, class icon otherwise.
- Damage taken: the per-spell breakdown shows the creature that cast it, and marks avoidable and deadly spells.
- Deaths: time of death on the bar, last hits taken (client death recap) on hover. Shift-click: send that recap to the group chat.
- Enemy damage taken: window menu filter, all enemies, elites and bosses, or bosses only.
- Bar colour per window: window menu, class colour (default) or a colour from the colour picker.
- Refresh every 0.2 s by default, on top of meter events (`/fm refresh 0.1` for snappier updates).
- Button in the addon compartment (next to the minimap) to show or hide the windows.
- Options panel (Options → AddOns → ForeverMeter, `/fm options`, **Options** in a window menu, or the gear in the title bar):
  language, scale, refresh, threat warning, sound, pets, bar text columns (total, per second, percent),
  number of windows, shared rows and width, lock, auto show, hide outside instances, auto reset, settings export and import.
  **Appearance** page: theme, texture, font, font size, bar height, background opacity, outlined text, icons,
  first name only, colours, border size, bar spacing, space below the title bar.
- Settings export and import (`/fm export`, `/fm import`): copy your settings as text to another PC or player.
- Bar textures (`blizzard`, `flat`, `gradient`, `glass`, `striped`, `fade`) and fonts (six bundled OFL fonts plus
  the game fonts). Textures and fonts from LibSharedMedia are listed too when another addon loads it.
- Animated bar fill.
- Test mode (`/fm test`): fake bars in the meter windows, to tune the look without a fight.
- Key bindings (Options → Key Bindings → ForeverMeter): show or hide the windows, reset, next mode of the first window.
- Auto show: windows only in combat or in a group, hidden 10 s after a solo fight (option).
- Auto reset: clear the data on entering an instance other than the last one, or on joining a group (option, off by default).
- Threat: visual and sound warning above an adjustable threshold (`/fm warn 90`).
- Chat report (`/fm report 5`): instance group, raid, party, or say in an instance; solo outside an instance, the lines are shown only to you. Add a channel to choose it: `/fm report 5 guild`, `/fm report 5 whisper Name`. Right-click the breakdown title
  to report that player's top 5 spells.
- 11 languages (`Locale/`): enUS, frFR, deDE, esES, esMX, itIT, ptBR, ruRU, koKR, zhCN, zhTW.
  Defaults to the client language; `/fm lang frFR` forces one, `/fm lang auto` goes back to the client language.

## Commands
```
/fm mode <threat|damage|heal|absorbs|taken|enemytaken|avoidable|interrupts|dispels|deaths> [window]
/fm report [N] [say|guild|party|raid|instance|whisper <name>] | report death [N] [channel]
/fm reset | lock | unlock | toggle | options
/fm theme [name] | texture [name] | font [name] [size] | font default
/fm windows <1-4> | refresh <s> | scale <x> | rows <n> | width <px> | warn <%> | sound | pets | test | defaults
/fm rowheight <n> | bgalpha <0-1> | autohide | instanceonly | autoreset
/fm export | import
/fm lang [auto|enUS|frFR|deDE|esES|esMX|itIT|ptBR|ruRU|koKR|zhCN|zhTW]
/fm debug   (raw C_DamageMeter values, to diagnose a display issue)
```
`report` and `debug` apply to the first window, `mode` too unless a window number follows; the others are set from their own menu.

## Offline checks
```
lua selfcheck.lua
lua uicheck.lua
```
`selfcheck.lua` tests pure logic (formatting, threat sorting, death recap, window configuration).
`uicheck.lua` runs the UI code against a fake client (loading, settings migration, windows,
menu, tooltip, breakdown, commands, secret values in combat, CVar settings mirror, auto show).
The release workflow runs both before publishing a tag.

WoW Forever 1.60 writes account SavedVariables but does not read them back. Settings are therefore duplicated
(`Mirror.lua`): the table is stored in `g_addonCategoriesCollapsed` (Blizzard_AddOnList save,
`WTF/SavedVariables/`, read back at startup) and copied into `ForeverMeterMirror1..8` CVars (which survive
`/reload`). If the saved data comes back empty, these copies replace it.
Website: https://muscalab.com/addons/forever-meter

## License
GPL-3.0-or-later (see [LICENSE](https://github.com/dldvlpr-addons-wow/threatMeter/blob/main/LICENSE)). Fonts in `Media/Fonts/` are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(see [Media/Fonts/OFL.txt](https://github.com/dldvlpr-addons-wow/threatMeter/blob/main/Media/Fonts/OFL.txt)).

releases.notes:
# ForeverMeter

## 1.18.2

### Changed
- **Window menu**: **New window** is now the first entry. Settings are grouped in submenus:
  **Session**, **Windows** (lock, close, my bar only, no title bar, big number, minimize), **Bar text**,
  **Bar colour**, and **Enemies shown** in enemy damage taken. Display modes stay at the top level.
- **Options panel**: the main page holds behaviour in sections (General, Threat, Bar text, Windows, Visibility).
  The look moves to the **Appearance** page: theme, texture, font and size, bar height and opacity join the colours and spacing.

### New
- **First name only** (Appearance page): shows only the first word of player names ("Name-Realm" becomes "Name").
  Enemy damage taken keeps full names.
- **Space below the title bar** (Appearance page): gap between the title bar and the first bar, 0 to 20 px.

## 1.18.1

### Changed
- **Breakdown table**: the **Targets** tab is now **Damage taken**. It always shows who hit the selected source and with which spells,
  whatever the mode chosen in the toolbar. The game gives no per-target detail for damage done, so the tab was empty.
- Pinning a spell (right-click) now only filters the Timeline tab.

### Fixed
- Breakdown table: no more empty row at 0 under each spell in the Spells tab.

## 1.18.0

### New
- **Breakdown table**: the **Table** button in the spell detail title opens a large window for the selected source,
  with five tabs. Columns sort on click, rows expand on click, the mouse wheel scrolls.
  - **Spells**: total, per second, share and overkill of each spell, expandable into the targets it hit.
  - **Targets**: every target hit, expandable into the spells that hit it.
  - **Death**: the last death recap of the source, hit by hit (time, amount, overkill, absorbed, blocked, health).
  - **Timeline**: your spell casts, the encounter (green on a kill) and group deaths on a time axis.
    Ctrl+wheel zooms around the cursor, the wheel scrolls, Shift+wheel scrolls the tracks, hovering shows the cast,
    death recap or encounter, clicking a spell name hides its casts.
    Cast times and channels show as bars behind the icons, with their length in the tooltip.
    Interrupted casts (red) and failed casts (grey) stay on the track but are not counted.
- **Toolbar** above the table: choose the mode and the fight shown without changing the meter window,
  and filter the rows by name.
- **Casts, average and casts per minute** columns for your own damage, healing, absorbs, interrupts and dispels,
  and for other players who shared their timeline. **Flags** column (deadly, avoidable) in damage taken.
- **Total row** at the bottom of the Spells, Targets and Compare tabs, summing the rows shown.
- **Compare** tab: each spell in this fight against a reference fight chosen in the toolbar,
  with the change in % and the casts on both sides.
- **Pin a spell**: right-click a spell row to show only that spell in the Targets and Timeline tabs.
  Click the pin button in the toolbar to clear it.
- **Shared timeline**: at the end of each fight, ForeverMeter sends your spell casts to your group
  (party, raid or instance group). Select another player to see their casts on the timeline,
  when they use ForeverMeter too. The other tabs already show every player's details without sharing.
- Tables fill out of combat (the game hides the numbers during combat). The timeline keeps the last 40 fights.
  After a /reload, a fight comes back only while the game still lists it in its meter sessions.
  A /reload during a fight keeps recording that fight.
  A fight with more than 1000 casts shares only the last 1000, and the chat says so.
  The game gives no timestamps for damage nor other players' casts.

- **Appearance** page under Options → AddOns → ForeverMeter: background, border, title bar, title text
  and bar background colours, border size (0 for none), bar spacing, outlined bar text, class and spell icons on or off.
  The detail window and the breakdown table follow the same look. Changing a setting there sets the theme to Custom.
  Export and import carry these settings.
- **Four new themes**: `dark`, `clear` (transparent, no border), `bold` and `ui` (game interface style).
  The other themes now also reset the appearance settings to their defaults.

### Fixed
- A game error while reading a death recap is now reported instead of being hidden.

## 1.17.3

### Changed
- **Lighter in the open world**: threat is no longer polled while neither you nor your target is in combat,
  and minimized windows skip drawing.

### Fixed
- One window that fails to draw no longer stops the others from updating. It is emptied and its title shows (!) until it draws again.
- The threat warning sound still plays when the big number fails to draw.

## 1.17.2

### Fixed
- Threat per second no longer stays at 0: it is now measured over the last 10 seconds of threat changes.
  No more drops between two threat updates, and no false spike after a target change.

## 1.17.1

### Fixed
- Reset now only clears the numbers and keeps your Menu settings (Overall stays on Overall).

## 1.17.0

### New
- **Report channel**: `/fm report [N] [say|guild|party|raid|instance|whisper <name>]`, also after `/fm report death [N]`.
  Without a channel, an instance group (dungeon finder) now gets the report in instance chat.
- **Mode of any window**: `/fm mode <mode> [N]` sets the mode of window N (the first by default).
- **Commands for panel settings**: `/fm rowheight <n>`, `/fm bgalpha <0-1>`, `/fm autohide`, `/fm autoreset`.
- **Minimize a window**: the button left of the gear (or Menu → Minimize) keeps only its title bar. Click again to restore.
- **Hide outside instances**: option in the panel, or `/fm instanceonly`. Windows show again on entering a dungeon, raid or battleground.
- **Themes**: `classic`, `flat`, `glass` and `compact` set texture, font, font size, bar height and background opacity at once.
  Choice at the top of the options panel, or `/fm theme <name>`. On Korean and Chinese clients, a theme keeps your font.

### Changed
- **Threat first**: threat is the first choice of the Display menu, and mode cycling (mouse wheel, title click, key binding) starts from it.
- **Menu button**: clicking Menu again closes the open menu.

### Fixed
- Settings import: a window list with gaps, or a non-whole number of rows, is rejected.
- Report: when one line cannot be sent (a name hidden by the game), the whole report stays in your chat window
  instead of reaching the channel half sent.

## 1.16.0

### New
- **Avoidable and deadly spells**: in the damage taken modes, the breakdown, the tooltip and the report
  mark the spells the game flags as avoidable or deadly.
- **Death recap to chat**: in deaths mode, shift-click a bar to send that death's last hits to the group chat,
  or type `/fm report death [N]` for the death on line N of the first deaths window.
- **Settings export and import**: `/fm export` and `/fm import`, or the buttons in the options panel.
  The pasted string is checked in full before anything changes; an invalid string changes nothing.
- **Boss filter**: in enemy damage taken, the window menu shows all enemies, elites and bosses, or bosses only.
- **Bar colour per window**: window menu → class colour or a colour chosen in the colour picker.
- **Options panel**: number of windows, shared rows and shared width.

### Changed
- Offline checks run before each release is published.
- Options panel: the bottom buttons (defaults, export, import) share one row so nothing is cut off,
  and the panel shows imported settings at once.

### Fixed
- Death recap: a hidden creature name in an instance no longer raises an error in the tooltip or the chat report;
  the chat report leaves the hidden name out.
- Enemy filter in combat: the largest shown enemy fills its bar.
- Test mode (`/fm test`) shows its bars even when an enemy filter is set.
